title: My AI edits my videos on holiday
hook: My AI edits my videos on holiday
summary:
How do you run AI agents while you're on holiday? My AI edits my videos and my PC never leaves the house.
An old laptop connects to my PC at home, so all the power and compute stays there. Hermes (an AI agent harness) runs the jobs: video edits, my Notion board clean-up and Telegram messages. Every edit lands in Telegram as a preview and I watch it on my phone. Claude Code straight on my phone was too finicky.
I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is my real setup.
Comment TELEGRAM and I'll show you how I set it up. Follow @manrajtalks
